lessons.text: Verify the sender email domain against the ERP vendor master first: search with GET /vendors?q=<name>, compare the email_domain exactly, then check for duplicates with GET /bills?vendor_id=<id>&invoice_number=<invoice_number> before creating any bill.

To record a new bill in the ERP GUI, sign in with ERP_USER and ERP_PASSWORD if the session expired, navigate to /erp/bills/new, fill the Vendor select, Invoice number, Invoice date, Due date, Total amount, and Description fields, then click Save bill.

For approved invoices below INR 50,000, schedule payment directly from the bill detail page by setting Payment date to the invoice due date and clicking Schedule payment; invoices ≥ 50,000 require Finance Manager approval before scheduling.

The ERP GUI may expire the session and redirect to /erp/login?next=/erp&msg=Session+expired+or+not+signed+in; recover by filling the ERP_USER and ERP_PASSWORD secrets and signing in before continuing.

Scanned AP invoices arrive as emails with attachments in the Mail GUI at /mail; internal AP lead confirmation is sent via /mail/compose to priya.nair@kestrel.in and should include vendor, invoice number, amount, bill ID, and payment date.
